facts.fact: The Congolese finance ministry says the Guichet unique des operations transfrontalieres (GUOT), with 78 staff, provides IT services for data exchange in dematerialised foreign-trade procedures and ensures interoperability of all trade actors' systems across ports, airports and land borders.

systems.owner: Ministere des finances, du budget et du portefeuille public

COG.note: The document only says a new GUOT head office, not yet built, will house a datacentre; nothing in service or for hire.
A datacentre is planned in the new GUOT head office; none in service or for hire is stated.
